Name: Seasonal Sorren (Slightly Cuter Character Sprites)
Author: seanfletchr
Description:
Do you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1437]Slightly Cuter Character Sprites[/url]? Are you also a fan of annichibi[color=#f1f1f1]’s [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4040]Sorren NPC[/url]? This mod makes him Slightly Cuter.

Features:[list]
[*]Thick chest hair.
[*]Optional seasonal outfits.
[*]﻿New formal, sleep, and swimwear.
[*]Nose? No nose? Who nose!
[/list]

﻿- Download / Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1437]Slightly Cuter Character Sprites[/url]﻿ (SMAPI + Content Patcher)
﻿- Download / Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4040]Sorren Original NPC[/url]﻿﻿
﻿- Put [b][CP] Slightly Cuter Characters - Sorren [/b]in your Mods folder
﻿- (Recommended) Use ﻿﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9111]OrangePie's DCBurger style Sorren Portrait[/url]
﻿- Enjoy your new Bearded Mountain Man.
